quests.title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part III

dialogue.t: The azure trees stand tall amid the snowy scene, the land is lonely and tranquil. Verily does one's third dish suit this atmosphere.

dialogue.sit: What kind of dish are you going to make this time?

dialogue.t: Well. Have you ever heard tell of a method known as "braising"? This technique did one discover upon reading through some culinary tomes.
A fancy did one take to it, and thus created a new recipe, "Braised Meat," with this culinary technique as its heart.
Now, this dish is hardly too tall a task for one's Supreme Cuisine Machine, but meat is key to this dish, and none but the best shall one have.
Thus did one activate a mechanism and pursue the scent of fine ingredients to this place.
The snow and wind drive hard here, and makes for slow work.
One is aware, Traveler, of your wealth of adventuring experience. Surely, then, a mere snowy mountain will prove no obstacle to you.
One thus requests that you go forthwith and retrieve some ingredients once more.

dialogue.sit: I'd like to have the recipe for this third dish, too.
Too cold to fly, are we?

dialogue.t: Your aid shall not be forgotten. For the completion of this errand shall one await you here.
Hmm. The mechanism has come to a halt. 'Tis must be the biting cold.
Allow one to restart it...
Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!
This should resolve the issue. Now then, Traveler, pursue the scent one has put you on and retrieve those ingredients.
Now then, Traveler, pursue the scent one has put you on and retrieve the ingredients one requires.
How goes your search? Secured the ingredients one desires, have you?
...What manner of morsel is this?
Chilled Meat... An apt name indeed.
It is of fair quality, too. Still, we shall need a small fire to thaw it out.
Fortunately, defrosting counts among the Supreme Cuisine Machine's functions.

dialogue.sit: It sure seems to have no shortage of functions, huh.

dialogue.t: Ah! Falsehoods. This device does not lack for missing functions. The ability to automatically gather ingredients, for one. Or automatic heat control, for that matter... one could go on.
Many improvements still must one make to it in the coming days.
We shall cease the idle talk there. The ingredients are prepared, one shall activate this device immediately.
The heat control shall still be left in your hands, Traveler.
One would have you report your readiness once you are sufficiently prepared.
Are you fully prepared, Traveler?
Then let us begin.
Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!
Hmm. Ready yourself, then, and inform one once it is so.
One shall entrust the heat control to you, Traveler.
One could not call the heat control desirable...
Well? Is the Braised Meat complete?
Mmm... A most wonderful flavor. One would have expected no less...
'Tis so. The completion of these three dishes has proven the reliability of one's Supreme Cuisine Machine.
We have but to solve the two issues of heat control and the automatic retrieval of ingredients, and this machine shall truly have achieved "all-in-one cooking."
Ah, yes, lest one forgets... Your Braised Meat recipe. With but one difference — this recipe involves the use of normal Raw Meat instead.
One deems that it might be inconvenient for you to scale this frigid mountain each time you wish to eat this meal...
Ordinary meat shall serve in ordinary occasions.
Regardless, you have one's thanks for your aid in foraging for ingredients.
To one's abode one must now return, and make further improvements to this device. Let us part here, then.
Should one require any further succor... perhaps one shall call upon you again.
A measure of faith one has that you shall not decline should that time come. Most highly does one regard your abilities and trustworthiness, after all.

quests.description: Cloud Retainer is preparing to use the “Supreme Cuisine Machine” to make three all-new dishes…
